#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# This public entry script contains no CLI implementation or credentials. The
# operator's own GitHub login downloads the installer from the private release.
printf '%s\n' \
  'Install the Rocket.Chat support-agent CLI' \
  'Downloads need GitHub CLI and your own access to the private release repository.' \
  'Live commands also need Infisical CLI, machine authentication or a personal login, and approved project access.' >&2

for command_name in node gh; do
  if ! command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$command_name" = node ]; then
      printf '%s\n' 'Install Node 20 or newer from https://nodejs.org/en/download, then retry.' >&2
    else
      printf '%s\n' 'Install GitHub CLI from https://cli.github.com/, then retry.' >&2
    fi
    exit 1
  fi
done
if ! node -e 'process.exit(Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0]) >= 20 ? 0 : 1)'; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Node 20 or newer is required. Update Node, then retry.' >&2
  exit 1
fi

# gh owns authentication. A piped installer can use the controlling terminal
# for native login; unattended installation must arrive with existing access.
if ! GH_HOST=github.com gh auth status --hostname github.com >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ( : < /dev/tty ) 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Sign in to GitHub with the account that has release access.' >&2
    if ! GH_HOST=github.com gh auth login --hostname github.com --web --git-protocol https < /dev/tty > /dev/tty; then
      printf '%s\n' 'GitHub sign-in did not complete. Run gh auth login, then retry.' >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  else
    printf '%s\n' 'Sign in first with gh auth login, then run this installer again.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Finish the authenticated download before executing it. A failed or truncated
# download never reaches Bash; the private installer verifies the CLI payload.
installer_temp=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rc-support-agent-install.XXXXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$installer_temp"' EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
if ! GH_HOST=github.com gh release download \
  --repo RocketChat/rc-support-agent-releases \
  --pattern install.sh --output "$installer_temp/install.sh"; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Download failed. Check your access to RocketChat/rc-support-agent-releases, then retry.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
GH_HOST=github.com bash "$installer_temp/install.sh" "$@"

# Install the Rocket.Chat support-agent CLI

This repository hosts the public installer entry script. CLI code and release
assets stay in a separate private repository. Your GitHub account needs read
access to `RocketChat/rc-support-agent-releases`.

## Install

Use macOS or Linux with Bash, Node 20 or newer, and GitHub CLI. Run:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://rocketchat.github.io/rc-support-agent-install/install.sh | bash
```

The entry script checks prerequisites and uses your existing GitHub login. If
you need to sign in, it offers GitHub CLI's native flow in a terminal. For an
unattended installation, complete `gh auth login` beforehand.

It downloads the private installer completely before executing it. That
installer verifies the CLI archive and bundle files, installs under your home
directory, and configures PATH. Open a new terminal, then run:

```bash
rc-support-agent system setup
rc-support-agent browse
```

`system setup` checks local prerequisites. Live commands also need Infisical
CLI and approved project access through machine authentication or an existing
personal Infisical login. Machine authentication does not require a separate
Infisical user account for each operator. Follow the setup output before your
first live command. Installing the CLI does not grant runtime access.

## Update or roll back

```bash
rc-support-agent system update --check
rc-support-agent system update --apply
rc-support-agent system rollback --apply
```

Updates and rollback ask for confirmation. Add `--yes` for an unattended
operation. See the [private release repository](https://github.com/RocketChat/rc-support-agent-releases)
for the complete operator guide.

## Inspect the entry script

Read [install.sh](install.sh) before running it. The entry script handles no
token values and installs no dependencies. It uses GitHub CLI's authentication
store and forwards installer options without evaluating them. For example:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://rocketchat.github.io/rc-support-agent-install/install.sh | bash -s -- --prefix "$HOME/tools/rc-support-agent" --no-modify-path
```
